fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records carry headline/articleBody-style fields sourced from the site's own NewsArticle JSON-LD; latest-mode records (RSS feed) carry title/link-style fields. Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, unexpected_shape).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, straight from the site's own JSON-LD (article mode only) -- paragraph breaks normalized from the site's raw \r\n\r\n separators.

authorUrl.title: Author URL
authorUrl.description: Link to the author's profile page on uzdaily.uz (article mode only).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher organization name, as emitted by the site's own JSON-LD (article mode only).

articleSection.title: Section
articleSection.description: Site section/category the article was published under (article mode only), e.g. "Economy", "Finance", "Uzbekistan".

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated keyword string, as emitted by the site's own JSON-LD (article mode only).

wordCount.title: Word count
wordCount.description: Article word count, as reported by the site's own JSON-LD (article mode only).

isAccessibleForFree.title: Free to access
isAccessibleForFree.description: Whether the article is paywalled, as reported by the site's own JSON-LD (article mode only) -- observed true on every sampled article, no paywall found.

teaser.title: Teaser
teaser.description: Short feed <description> teaser, not the full article body (latest mode).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: Feed item's internal article ID (latest mode).

thumbnail.title: Thumbnail
thumbnail.description: Lead image URL from the feed's <enclosure> element (latest mode).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RFC 822 publish timestamp as given by the feed (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
